## Is Hericium Erinaceus Extract safe?  
**Hericium erinaceus extract** has high safety and tolerance. As a natural plant extract, lion's mane mushroom extract shows good safety and tolerance during long-term use. Compared with some chemically synthesized immunopotentiators, Hericium erinaceus extract powder has fewer side effects and is safer and more reliable to use.
